notes.title: Update 0.8.3 is live
notes.content:
We've added a whole new game mode called Gun Game where you battle through waves of monsters while your weapon keeps changing to a better one every few kills. To win this game mode you need to reach to the last weapon.

Additionally we added a much of new smaller features and fixed some more bugs:
- Added LIV Support for Mixed Reality Streaming
- Next Round Indicator now shows up on every new round
- Pyramid of Terror Rock Golem's area has been populated with more houses and props
- Ammo pack and Ammo Crate models have been updated to look better
- Special Thanks section has been added to the credits menu
- Melee weapon vibrating in the wrong hands has been fixed

notes.title: Major Update 0.8.0 (+ Open Beta)
notes.content:
We hope you'll enjoy our biggest update so far!

We finished up most of the game systems and mechanics at this point together with most enemy types and stages.
This will be the last incremental update before the release of the full version 1.0.
From this point we want to take a few more months to polish up the game and get rid of some bugs for the full release. We also plan on adding a couple of more stages and boss encounters coming with that.

Alongside players who own the game on steam we also want to give beta access to outside users for a limited time to get feedback on balancing and the game feel.
If you don't own the game and want to participate join our discord for instructions:
discord.gg/t9Yf68P
